text:
alex: quick thread — leadership wants a crisp plan for automated SOC2 evidence exports + tenant-level retention + cost allocation for enterprise contracts. need product acceptance criteria and rough estimates.

mike: customers asking for quarterly audit bundles (PDF + raw events) and per-tenant billing line items for retention. they want retention windows by region.

sophia: proposal: two export modes — "compliance bundle" (signed, immutable package for auditors) and "self-serve query dump" (CSV/JSON for customer use). compliance bundle includes manifest + cert.

lee: engineering thoughts: large tenants will need staged exports. generating a 5-year bundle could be terabytes. suggest background export jobs with pagination and resumability.

anita: security: bundles must be integrity-protected (sha256 + signing key). also need to log export access events and include chain-of-custody metadata. rotation & KMS rules must be defined.

drew: finance: we must gate retention by cost tiers. propose pricing SKU: base + per-GB-year for archival + export fee. also need telemetry for expected ingest growth to model costs.

mike: legal asks: retention overrides for legal hold and a revocation mechanism. auditors prefer tamper-proof timestamps and chain-of-custody.

sophia: example manifest schema (draft):
```
- bundle_id: uuid
- tenant_id: string
- created_at: iso8601
- region: string
- files: [ { name: string, sha256: hex, size_bytes: int } ]
- exported_by: string
- signature: base64
```
Include a human-readable summary PDF.

lee: infra pieces: export-runner queue, multipart archive builder, signed manifest service, cold storage lifecycle (hot->warm->cold), export SLA worker. rough estimate: 4 sprints to deliver self-serve dumps + basic bundle signing if we reuse existing archiver.

anita: acceptance criteria (security): exported bundles verify locally with provided signature, export audit events stored for 7 years, private keys used for signing are rotated and auditable.
drew: acceptance criteria (finance): export cost calc appears on tenant bill; retention tier change takes effect within 24h; projected monthly cost report available for sales.

alex: product acceptance criteria (MVP hosted): 
- tenants can select retention by region with presets (90d, 1y, 5y)
- compliance bundle generation API + UI with signed manifest and human summary
- legal hold flag that prevents deletion and triggers export readiness
- billing shows retention cost and export fees per tenant
- operational runbook for exports and SLA (default 72h turnaround)

mike: can we offer expedited export SLA for an add-on? customers will pay.

drew: yes, chargeable expedited exports (24h, same-day concierge). model that separately.

lee: blocker list: - storage costs spike for multi-year retention - ROI on building search over cold archives - KMS/signing key management and HSM requirements - cross-region data transfer for bundled exports

anita: risk register: - if bundles are malformed we fail audits - escalation for subpoena/warrant access - accidental disclosure during export pipeline

sophia: mitigation: staged QA for bundle validator, integration test with a sample external auditor, and pre-signed read-only links for bundles.

alex: timeline thoughts: MVP (hosted): 6 weeks for retention UI + storage lifecycle + billing hook, 6-8 weeks to add bundle generator + signing + basic export UI. stretch 1-2 sprints for scale testing.

ops-bot: Reminder: create RFC in #docs-requests and attach initial design doc.

alex: next steps: 1) Lee to spike export-runner feasibility and storage cost estimate (EOD Fri). 2) Sophia to draft manifest + PDF template and sample API (by Tue). 3) Anita to list signing/KMS requirements and review HSM options. 4) Drew to propose pricing tiers and estimate per-tenant costs. we'll review in product sync next week.

mike: thanks — I'll start customer comms draft and collect sample auditor requirements.

alex: thanks all. leaving thread open for any quick updates. :thumbsup:
